Container.Name: expense-pilot
Container.Overview: Employment and business expenses, AI receipt drafts and overnight meals. Run prepare.sh to create the data directory before installing. Private GHCR image: authenticate Docker to ghcr.io first. AI is configured inside the app. The setup token is optional; if you leave it blank, create your owner account before exposing the server remotely. The setup script or first container start saves the logo in appdata. Icon URL uses this local file; if you change the host Appdata path, update Icon URL in Advanced View to match.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent database, receipts and session key. Keep this mapping during updates.

Config.Name: Setup token
Config.Description: Optional first-run protection. Leave blank for token-free setup, or enter a random value of at least 24 characters. Complete owner setup before exposing the server remotely.

Config.Name: Secure cookie
Config.Description: Use true behind HTTPS. Use false for initial LAN HTTP setup.
